verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only that Digits has an invoicing feature ('Invoicing Get paid faster') and A/R aging reporting. Nothing documents recurring invoice schedules or automatic payment reminders for overdue customers. Generic invoicing and aging reports are adjacent features, not the recurring-schedule and automated-reminder capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set up recurring invoices and automatic payment reminders for overdue customers
